# GlobalPulse

> Self-hosted scheduled market briefings on Cloudflare Workers.
> Finance / A-share / US stock / crypto / hotspot digests pushed to Feishu, WeChat, Telegram, and Email.

## Docs

- https://innonestx.github.io/GlobalPulse/en/

- https://innonestx.github.io/GlobalPulse/en/compare.html
- https://innonestx.github.io/GlobalPulse/en/features.html

self-hosted market briefing, Cloudflare Workers cron, Feishu bot digest, Telegram finance newsletter, A-share morning brief, WeChat work bot, open source market intelligence, scheduled news push
